}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "X7868-ZOOM VER:1.2" and "2005.01.18" is silkscreened :on the board used to populate this entry. The board is using two differing brands of radial capacitors :- '''TAICON''' (power section) and '''CUSHY''' (main board, :all are - as of 2013 - swollen or ruptured).
'''Additional info...''' :The ''Argon 432'' SoC is labeled with.. :*The ''[[Conexant]]'' logo :*DA4-9431-PCA Z :*0609 Taiwan :*0608GWJ9-A3 :*''ARM'' :The Mini PCI card is using [[Intersil]] ISL3886IKZ.
The OUI used by the device, for both interfaces, :is presumed to be 00:01:38 (''[[XAVi]]'').
